hero.title: A small studio with exacting standards.
hero.subtitle: Nodium started with a simple frustration: most digital products are built for screenshots, not for real work. We set out to make tools that respect your time and your taste.
hero.imageAlt: Minimal monochrome desk scene with a laptop and a stack of paper

story: Nodium began in 2022 as a single Notion template shared with a few hundred subscribers. The response was surprising: people kept writing in — not for support, but to say the template had quietly changed how they worked. So we kept going, one product at a time.

Today Nodium is a catalogue of 35+ templates, tools and automations used by more than 12,000 customers in 40+ countries. We're still a small team. We still hand-build everything. And we still ship every product as if the person buying it is the only person we'll ever have.

faqs.q: What exactly do I get when I purchase?
faqs.a: Instant access to the product and every file it includes — templates, workflows, source files and documentation — plus lifetime updates and the license described on the product page. Your download links are available immediately after checkout and are also emailed to you.
Digitally, immediately. After checkout you land on an order confirmation page with download links for every item in your order. The same links are emailed to you, and they never expire.

It depends on the product, and every product page lists its exact formats. As a rule: Notion templates ship as duplicate links, documents as PDF + DOCX/EPUB, websites as clean HTML/CSS/JS, spreadsheets as Excel + Google Sheets, and automations as importable JSON with PDF guides.

faqs.q: Can I use Nodium products commercially?
faqs.a: Yes. Every product includes a commercial license, so you can use it in client work and business projects. The one thing you cannot do is resell, redistribute or repackage the raw files themselves.
Yes — lifetime updates, included free with every purchase. When a product improves, the new version appears in your library at no cost. We never charge for updates.
If a product isn't right for you, email us within 14 days of purchase and we'll refund it in full — no questions, no forms. Digital products that have been redistributed are the only exception.
Email hello@nodium.co and a real human (not a bot) replies within 24 hours on business days. Include your order number if you have one and we'll move faster.
No. Every product is a one-time purchase. You own it forever, including all future updates. There are no hidden fees, no membership tiers and no 'pro' upsells.

faqs.q: Do I need technical skills to use these products?
faqs.a: No. Every product is designed for non-technical use and ships with a setup guide. n8n workflows and website templates assume a little comfort with files, but each one includes step-by-step documentation.

faqs.q: Can you build something custom for our team?
faqs.a: Often, yes. We take on a limited number of bespoke projects — internal tools, automation systems and template suites. Email us through the contact page and tell us about the process you want to fix.

faqs.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: All major credit and debit cards via Stripe, with PayPal arriving soon. All payments are processed securely and nothing is stored on our servers.

faqs.q: Do you offer team or business licenses?
faqs.a: Yes. If you're buying for a team of 5 or more, email us for volume pricing and a single-invoice option. Teams get the same lifetime-update guarantee.
